records.translation: ``'float64'``（默认值，即条目 936 之前的算术，逐位一致）或 ``'float32'``，后者在单线程上用 ``scipy.fft`` 以 float32 计算 CPU 相关曲面，并就地归一化。在 Funk et al. 2022 的板 A 至 D 的 A1 孔上，float32 曲面在全部 624 条边上给出了相同的整数位移和接受结果，CPU 时间减半。它只改变 CPU（NumPy）曲面；GPU 后端本来就以 float32 运行。

records.context: how many worker processes register the edges (item 936). 1, the default, registers them one after another in this process. More cuts each pair's two overlap strips here and registers them in that many processes, on the CPU, with the same edges, acceptances and placements; on well A1 of Funk et al. 2022 three workers cut the placement wall time about three-fold at the same CPU time. Workers start ten seconds apart, as every spaCR process pool does, so the gain shows only on microplate sample positions that take longer than that.
records.label: spacr.ops_stitch.stitch_well#9
records.source: how many worker processes register the edges (item 936). 1, the default, registers them one after another in this process. More cuts each pair's two overlap strips here and registers them in that many processes, on the CPU, with the same edges, acceptances and placements; on well A1 of Funk et al. 2022 three workers cut the placement wall time about three-fold at the same CPU time. Workers start ten seconds apart, as every spaCR process pool does, so the gain shows only on wells that take longer than that.
records.translation: 用多少个工作进程配准各条边（条目 936）。1 为默认值，在本进程中逐条配准。大于 1 时，在此处切出每对图块的两个重叠条带，并在相应数量的进程中于 CPU 上配准，得到相同的边、接受结果和放置位置；在 Funk et al. 2022 的 A1 孔上，三个工作进程在 CPU 时间相同的情况下将放置的实际耗时缩短到约三分之一。与 spaCR 的所有进程池一样，各工作进程相隔十秒启动，因此只有耗时超过十秒的孔才能看到收益。

records.context: spaCR stitches tiles in two places that matter: the general Align & Stitch module (:mod:`spacr.align`) and the optical pooled screening chain (:mod:`spacr.ops_register`, :mod:`spacr.ops_solve`, :mod:`spacr.ops_stitch`, :mod:`spacr.ops_compose`). The OPS chain is the one proven against reference data: 624 of 624 edges on well A1 of Funk et al. 2022, a deterministic solve, feathered seams that score like an unstitched tile (item 931), float32 registration at half the CPU time (the S1 stitch speed card). This module is the one place both callers take that code from:
records.label: spacr.stitch_core#1
records.source: spaCR stitches tiles in two places that matter: the general Align & Stitch module (:mod:`spacr.align`) and the optical pooled screening chain (:mod:`spacr.ops_register`, :mod:`spacr.ops_solve`, :mod:`spacr.ops_stitch`, :mod:`spacr.ops_compose`). The OPS chain is the one proven against reference data: 624 of 624 edges on well A1 of Funk et al. 2022, a deterministic solve, feathered seams that score like an unstitched tile (item 931), float32 registration at half the CPU time (the S1 stitch speed card). This module is the one place both callers take that code from:
records.translation: spaCR 在两个关键位置拼接图块：通用的 Align & Stitch 模块（:mod:`spacr.align`）以及光学混池筛选链（:mod:`spacr.ops_register`、:mod:`spacr.ops_solve`、:mod:`spacr.ops_stitch`、:mod:`spacr.ops_compose`）。OPS 链是经过参考数据验证的那一条：在 Funk et al. 2022 的 A1 孔上 624 条边中 624 条被接受、求解结果确定、羽化接缝的得分与未拼接图块相当（条目 931），以及 CPU 时间减半的 float32 配准（S1 拼接速度卡片）。本模块是两个调用方获取这些代码的唯一来源：

records.context: the registration: :func:`phase_correlate`, :func:`unwrap`, :func:`available_backends`, :func:`register_edge`, the float32 transform engine :class:`FFTEngine` (item 932), and :func:`register_strip_pair`, which adds the NCC check and sub-pixel refinement Align & Stitch needs on top of the same strip registration;

records.source: the registration: :func:`phase_correlate`, :func:`unwrap`, :func:`available_backends`, :func:`register_edge`, the float32 transform engine :class:`FFTEngine` (item 932), and :func:`register_strip_pair`, which adds the NCC check and sub-pixel refinement Align & Stitch needs on top of the same strip registration;
records.translation: 配准：:func:`phase_correlate`、:func:`unwrap`、:func:`available_backends`、:func:`register_edge`、float32 变换引擎 :class:`FFTEngine`（条目 932），以及 :func:`register_strip_pair`，它在同一条带配准之上增加了 Align & Stitch 所需的 NCC 检查和亚像素细化；

records.context: The OPS functions are the same objects as in their modules (``stitch_core.phase_correlate is ops_register.phase_correlate``), so every OPS import, test and reference keeps working and nothing is implemented twice. They are attributes of this module but are documented, and listed in ``__all__``, only where they are defined. No Qt and no torch are imported here; torch and CuPy are imported only inside the GPU backends of :func:`phase_correlate`.
records.label: spacr.stitch_core#6
records.source: The OPS functions are the same objects as in their modules (``stitch_core.phase_correlate is ops_register.phase_correlate``), so every OPS import, test and reference keeps working and nothing is implemented twice. They are attributes of this module but are documented, and listed in ``__all__``, only where they are defined. No Qt and no torch are imported here; torch and CuPy are imported only inside the GPU backends of :func:`phase_correlate`.
records.translation: OPS 函数与其所在模块中的是同一对象（``stitch_core.phase_correlate is ops_register.phase_correlate``），因此所有 OPS 导入、测试和引用都能继续工作，也没有任何东西被实现两遍。它们是本模块的属性，但只在定义它们的地方编写文档并列入 ``__all__``。这里不导入 Qt 和 torch；torch 和 CuPy 只在 :func:`phase_correlate` 的 GPU 后端内部导入。

records.context: Every accepted edge ``(a, b) -> (dy, dx)`` is one equation ``p_b - p_a = (dy, dx)`` and all of them are solved at once by least squares, so measurement error is spread over the graph rather than accumulated along a path. The gauge -- a pure pair graph fixes positions only up to a translation -- is fixed one of two ways:
records.label: spacr.stitch_core.solve_positions#1
records.source: Every accepted edge ``(a, b) -> (dy, dx)`` is one equation ``p_b - p_a = (dy, dx)`` and all of them are solved at once by least squares, so measurement error is spread over the graph rather than accumulated along a path. The gauge -- a pure pair graph fixes positions only up to a translation -- is fixed one of two ways:
records.translation: 每条被接受的边 ``(a, b) -> (dy, dx)`` 都是一个方程 ``p_b - p_a = (dy, dx)``，所有方程通过最小二乘一次性求解，因此测量误差分摊到整个图上，而不是沿某条路径累积。规范（gauge）——纯图块对图只能确定到相差一个平移的位置——以下列两种方式之一固定：

records.context: ``'lowest_site'`` (OPS): the lowest site of each connected component is pinned at the origin, unweighted, exactly :func:`spacr.ops_solve.solve_placements`;
records.label: spacr.stitch_core.solve_positions#2
records.source: ``'lowest_site'`` (OPS): the lowest site of each connected component is pinned at the origin, unweighted, exactly :func:`spacr.ops_solve.solve_placements`;
records.translation: ``'lowest_site'``（OPS）：每个连通分量中编号最小的位点固定在原点，不加权，与 :func:`spacr.ops_solve.solve_placements` 完全相同；

records.context: ``'anchor'`` (Align & Stitch): every site gets a weak equation ``p = anchor`` of weight ``anchor_weight`` and each edge its own weight, exactly ``spacr.align.solve_positions``; a microscope image field in no edge lands on its anchor.
records.label: spacr.stitch_core.solve_positions#3
records.source: ``'anchor'`` (Align & Stitch): every site gets a weak equation ``p = anchor`` of weight ``anchor_weight`` and each edge its own weight, exactly ``spacr.align.solve_positions``; a tile in no edge lands on its anchor.
records.translation: ``'anchor'``（Align & Stitch）：每个位点获得一个弱方程 ``p = anchor``，其权重为 ``anchor_weight``，每条边有各自的权重，与 ``spacr.align.solve_positions`` 完全相同；不属于任何边的图块落在其锚点上。

records.context: The solve runs on ``blas_threads`` BLAS threads, one by default, so two runs give byte-identical positions whatever the machine's thread count.
records.label: spacr.stitch_core.solve_positions#4
records.source: The solve runs on ``blas_threads`` BLAS threads, one by default, so two runs give byte-identical positions whatever the machine's thread count.
records.translation: 求解在 ``blas_threads`` 个 BLAS 线程上运行，默认一个，因此无论机器有多少线程，两次运行给出的位置都逐字节一致。

records.context: ``(a, b) -> (dy, dx)`` or anything carrying ``.shift``, b's position minus a's, for the accepted pairs. Under ``'anchor'`` it may also be a sequence of ``(a, b, dy, dx)`` or ``(a, b, dy, dx, weight)`` rows, which may repeat a pair, as Align & Stitch's edge lists do.
records.label: spacr.stitch_core.solve_positions#5
records.source: ``(a, b) -> (dy, dx)`` or anything carrying ``.shift``, b's position minus a's, for the accepted pairs. Under ``'anchor'`` it may also be a sequence of ``(a, b, dy, dx)`` or ``(a, b, dy, dx, weight)`` rows, which may repeat a pair, as Align & Stitch's edge lists do.
records.translation: 被接受图块对的 ``(a, b) -> (dy, dx)``，或任何带有 ``.shift`` 的对象，即 b 的位置减去 a 的位置。在 ``'anchor'`` 下，它也可以是由 ``(a, b, dy, dx)`` 或 ``(a, b, dy, dx, weight)`` 行组成的序列，可重复同一对，与 Align & Stitch 的边列表相同。

records.context: The checks, in order: the laboratory microplate and microplate sample position (case and zero padding ignored); the microscope image field IDs (``'strict'``: the run's sites equal the file's, ``'subset'``: every site of the run is in the file); the layout count (highest site + 1); the microscope image field shape and pixel type; the acquisition and cycle; ``ops_align_model='tile_affine'`` with no microscope image field groups in the file; the source files (changed files are a warning under ``'subset'`` and an error under ``'strict'``); and a file written by another spaCR version (a warning). A value given as None is not checked.
records.label: spacr.stitch_core.validate_placement_seed#1
records.source: The checks, in order: the plate and well (case and zero padding ignored); the tile IDs (``'strict'``: the run's sites equal the file's, ``'subset'``: every site of the run is in the file); the layout count (highest site + 1); the tile shape and pixel type; the acquisition and cycle; ``ops_align_model='tile_affine'`` with no tile groups in the file; the source files (changed files are a warning under ``'subset'`` and an error under ``'strict'``); and a file written by another spaCR version (a warning). A value given as None is not checked.
records.translation: 检查依次为：板和孔（忽略大小写和补零）；图块 ID（``'strict'``：本次运行的位点与文件中的相同，``'subset'``：本次运行的每个位点都在文件中）；布局计数（最大位点 + 1）；图块形状和像素类型；采集和循环；``ops_align_model='tile_affine'`` 且文件中没有图块组；源文件（已更改的文件在 ``'subset'`` 下为警告，在 ``'strict'`` 下为错误）；以及由其他 spaCR 版本写入的文件（警告）。给定为 None 的值不检查。
